googleAnalytics.title: UTM Campaign Performance — May 23 to July 30, 2026

eventCount.label: Event count
eventCount.definition: Total number of events recorded. An event is any user interaction tracked in GA4 (page views, clicks, scrolls, etc.). Higher event counts indicate more overall engagement from that traffic source.

engagedSessions.label: Engaged sessions
engagedSessions.definition: The number of sessions that lasted longer than 10 seconds, had a conversion event, or had 2 or more screen/page views. This filters out bounces and shows sessions where users actually interacted.

sessions.label: Sessions
sessions.definition: A session is a group of user interactions with your website within a given time frame (default 30 minutes). Each visit starts a new session. This is the broadest traffic metric — all visitors, including bounces.

keyEvents.label: Key events
keyEvents.definition: Events marked as particularly important to your business. These are your conversions — actions like form submissions, purchases, or phone calls. 0 key events recorded in this period. Note: There is currently no way to attribute online purchases back to individual campaigns, so key events may underrepresent campaign-driven conversions.

insights: Newsletter campaigns (mmai/newsletter + newsletter/july-2026-sale + mmai/newsletter-july-2026) drove 2,776 events — 62.7% of all traffic. Newsletters are the dominant traffic engine.
Outdoor-intent sequences (ai-intent-mmai + mmai) combined: 535 events, 46 sessions — consistent performer though ai-intent-mmai declined -29% vs prior period.
4th of July campaign: 422 events, 29 sessions — strong GA debut despite low email open rate (2.80%).
Existing customers: 374 events, 23 sessions — slight decline in events (-11%) but sessions up +44%, indicating more unique visitors spending less time per visit.
Team-intent: 101 events, 15 sessions, 53.3% engagement rate — the highest quality traffic across all campaigns.
Overall engagement rate: 48.0% (132/275 sessions) — healthy and up from prior period.
0 key events (conversions) — online purchases cannot currently be tied back to individual campaigns, so key events may underrepresent true campaign-driven conversions.
📈 Volume doubled: 14,160 sends vs 7,138 prior (+98%) — MailChimp list + 4th of July drove massive growth with excellent list quality.
📉 Bounce rate collapsed: 5.56% → 2.82% — only 3 new bounces on 7,022 additional sends. The new lists are extremely clean.
📰 Newsletters are the traffic engine: 2,776 GA events (62.7%) from newsletter campaigns — the dominant driver of website visits.
🎯 MailChimp sequence is the hidden gem: 9.96% OR, 1.01% CTR, 4 replies — best engagement of any new sequence with near-zero bounce rate (0.06%).
⭐ Existing Customers open rate actually improved: 5.66% → 6.88% (+1.22pp) — counter to the typical decline as campaigns age. The SMS+email combo is working.

📬 Deliverability is rock-solid: 0% spam rate, 100% authentication (DKIM/SPF/DMARC), and near-zero delivery errors per Google Postmaster Tools. The 'Bad' domain reputation is a volume artifact, not a real problem.
⚠️ 4th of July sequence underperforming: 2.80% OR on 3,464 members — large list but low engagement. Being replaced by Bonus Days August campaigns running on fresh, more accurate intent data.
📤 Unsubscribe rate is healthy: 70 unsubscribes across 14,160 sends = 0.49% — well under the 1% industry threshold. All organic (email link), with one spike of 9 on June 29.

💬 Replies doubled with strong sentiment: 5 to 11 replies (10 human). Platform AI classifies 7 of 9 human replies as Interested or Positive. Judy Field replied twice, Shelly Duncan, Bob Orr, and others showing genuine interest.
📊 GA traffic exploded +169%: 1,645 → 4,426 events across the 68-day period.
🧹 List hygiene completed: Merged and cleaned customer database — 4,799 → 4,684 verified contacts after removing 18 duplicates and 97 bouncing addresses.
nextSteps: 🚀 Launch Bonus Days August 2026 campaigns on August 1 — both Outdoor Furniture Intent and Existing Customers sequences are ready. The intent list will be built fresh on August 1st to ensure the most accurate, up-to-date targeting data.
🔄 Replace 4th of July sequence with Bonus Days August — the 2.80% open rate on 3,464 members is well below benchmark. Bonus Days August will run on freshly curated intent data for better targeting.
🔍 Revive Anonymous Visitors sequence in August — test the Agent Loop step and enable email validation inside the sequence to address the 20.33% bounce rate.

📋 Run a fresh customer database audit at the end of August — last full audit was July 30th in preparation for the August newsletter broadcast and sequence. Also verify the main sending domain (getporchandpatiostore.com) in Google Postmaster Tools for more accurate deliverability monitoring.
📊 Verify getporchandpatiostore.com in Google Postmaster Tools — the porchandpationewsletter.com domain shows clean delivery but low volume. The main sending domain will give better reputation data.
